w/o adding `-Dtests.rand=$RANDOM` would actually run the test 100 times?
This test has failed 9 times within last 5 days. I am reopening it.

Checked 5 latest failures. All of them are failing on `useRateLimits == false` condition, meaning that test was instructed to disable rate limiting but it happened anyway

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/cdabe88242d93030444f77943c4e0ea0066f0527/x-pack/plugin/searchable-snapshots/src/internalClusterTest/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/searchablesnapshots/SearchableSnapshotsIntegTests.java#L506-L509

```
13:41:57     Expected: <0L>
13:41:57          but: was <33075429L>
13:41:57         at __randomizedtesting.SeedInfo.seed([F5CDB138FAA960D3:D899432AC8369781]:0)
13:41:57         at org.hamcrest.MatcherAssert.assertThat(MatcherAssert.java:18)
13:41:57         at org.junit.Assert.assertThat(Assert.java:956)
13:41:57         at org.junit.Assert.assertThat(Assert.java:923)
13:41:57         at org.elasticsearch.xpack.searchablesnapshots.SearchableSnapshotsIntegTests.testMaxRestoreBytesPerSecIsUsed(SearchableSnapshotsIntegTests.java:506)
```

Why it happens?

Recovery uses augmented `InputStream` which is guarded by **TWO** rate limiters and **ONE** callback listener. When any of rate limiter engage, the listener gets invoked.  

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/6d72e5c5d05b72073f25d0f461171adb7bfea6d0/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/repositories/blobstore/BlobStoreRepository.java#L3138-L3144

Currently test disables only one (configured in BlobStoreRepository) rate limiter leaving the second (comes from RecoverySettings) intact. Fix would be disabling the second rate limiter whilst keep asserting zero throttling callback invokes.
